_comment: Local corrections to the community dat schema (../schema.min.json). Per table either "patch": { "<column number, 0-based>": "Name" or { name, type, array, references } } to name or retype a column, "append": [columns] for columns added at the end of a row, or "columns": [...] to give the whole row layout by hand. A column is { name, type, array?, interval?, references? } with type one of bool string i16 u16 i32 u32 f32 enumrow row foreignrow array. See PATCHDAY.md.
